metadata.description: Demo subset for code_demo.ipynb (iteration-8 top-five ban study, gen_plan_experiment_6_idx7): S-mean residual-stream states of Qwen3-32B (C6, thinking on; states from unsloth/Qwen3-32B-bnb-4bit nf4) for 100 forced-algorithm prompts and the 17 baseline/ban prompts, plus the upstream tables the geometry and landing stages read.
metadata.source: tp_geometry rows of full_method_out.json + cache/states/smean_C6_nf4.npz + results/*.json
metadata.subset: 100 of the 300 forced prompts: each of the 10 algorithms x each forced template t = 0..9 with alias j = t mod 3 (group = 3t + j, as in src/prompts_tp.py)
metadata.state_encoding: state(block) = block_mean + residual; block_mean_f32_b64 = base64 of a little-endian float32 array of shape (len(blocks), hidden_size); every *state_f16_b64 = base64 of a little-endian float16 residual array of the same shape
